title: fieldwork::misskey_api — Misskey Client API route handlers
description: Implement Misskey API endpoints. Misskey API uses POST for everything (no GET for data), JSON-RPC-style. Key endpoints: /api/notes/create, /api/notes/reactions/create, /api/drive/files/create, /api/users/show, /api/antennas/create, /api/i (current user). Very different from REST-style Mastodon API. Reusable by all three servers.
